purpose: Teach: キロメートル/秒間/車掌/電柱/ノース/サウス/サッシ/リール

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、店舗まで毎日五キロメートル歩かれた
lines.en: Your father walked five kilometers every day to the store when he was founding it.
lines.style: Warm, measured recollection. Eyes distant but present. Soft emphasis on the dailiness of the sacrifice, not the distance itself.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは事業の判断を秒間単位で下された
lines.en: Yes. He made business decisions in seconds.
lines.style: Quiet affirmation. Direct, steady eye contact. A son recognizing his father's clarity — not boasting, just stating fact with steady breath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、鉄道の車掌の方々と親しかった
lines.en: When he was young, he was close with the railroad conductors.
lines.style: Voice softens. A small smile in the memory. Slower pace, like holding something precious. Slight lift at 'close' — fondness for that friendship.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは台風で倒れた電柱の復旧を支援された
lines.en: Yes. He helped restore the electric poles when the typhoon knocked them down.
lines.style: Steady, deliberate. Pride threaded through but held back. Speaks like he's placing each word carefully, honoring an act of quiet service.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、北米のノース支社を一から開かれた
lines.en: He opened the North American branch from nothing.
lines.style: Voice carries weight of accomplishment. Slight pause before 'opened' — sitting with the scale of it. Slower cadence. Admiration held steady.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは南米のサウス拠点でも信頼を築かれた
lines.en: Yes. He built trust at the South American office too.
lines.style: Firm but not cold. Recognition of breadth — not just one success but reliability across continents. Clear, measured delivery. Nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本社のサッシ職人と長年お付き合いされた
lines.en: He maintained a long friendship with the master sash craftsman at headquarters.
lines.style: Tender, almost hushed. The word 'long' lingers slightly — speaks to loyalty and constancy. A personal detail, not a business detail. Affection in the pacing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは8ミリリールの広告映像を残された
lines.en: Yes. He left behind eight-millimeter film of the company's early advertisements.
lines.style: Final reflection. Slow, gentle close. Weight of legacy — not boastful, but a son understanding what his father preserved. Exhale at the end, like completion.
